contracts.method_prerequisites_limits: First secure word/statement access and distinguish access support from answer hints; each method is a conditional design candidate, not a prerequisite lock or established effect. See preserved-and-refined method rows.
contracts.independent_check_conditions: Named independent_check activity is a content candidate. Before use, human/content/rights/Gold/rubric qualification, learner-specific shared/normalized body and hint exposure, input version, first unaided response freeze, assistance conditions and independent scoring must be validated. No student unseen stock currently counted.
contracts.transfer_task: Use a different source/topic/type where the same performance is required; record changed/constant conditions and learner exposure. Candidate source refs are development-exposed, not actual successful transfer observations.
contracts.delayed_task: Use a previously qualified performance prompt on an actual later occasion; record elapsed time, intervening study, supports and memory exposure. Repeated identical source is retention on that source, not automatically transfer.
contracts.evidence_and_unverified_effects: Source binding + investigator-authored logical Gold only; no human expert/learner/scorer reliability/comparative teaching effects. R3/R4/R5 promotion blocked.

contracts.method_prerequisites_limits: First secure word/statement access and distinguish access support from answer hints; each method is a conditional design candidate, not a prerequisite lock or established effect. See preserved-and-refined method rows.
contracts.independent_check_conditions: Named independent_check activity is a content candidate. Before use, human/content/rights/Gold/rubric qualification, learner-specific shared/normalized body and hint exposure, input version, first unaided response freeze, assistance conditions and independent scoring must be validated. No student unseen stock currently counted.
contracts.transfer_task: Use a different source/topic/type where the same performance is required; record changed/constant conditions and learner exposure. Candidate source refs are development-exposed, not actual successful transfer observations.
contracts.delayed_task: Use a previously qualified performance prompt on an actual later occasion; record elapsed time, intervening study, supports and memory exposure. Repeated identical source is retention on that source, not automatically transfer.
contracts.evidence_and_unverified_effects: Source binding + investigator-authored logical Gold only; no human expert/learner/scorer reliability/comparative teaching effects. R3/R4/R5 promotion blocked.
